command: set -euo pipefail; cd "$HOME/local-agent"; git switch main; git fetch --prune origin main; git reset --hard origin/main; test "$(python3 -c 'import agent_version; print(agent_version.RELEASE_VERSION)')" = "4.9.6"; for b in v4.9.4-adaptive-polling v4.9.5-active-poll-priority v4.9.5-supervisor-control-handoff v4.9.6-hot-path v4.9.7-tail-latency cleanup-marker-do-not-use v4.9.6-finalize-stable temporary-cleanup-helper x cleanup-now ignore-this temp-delete-me final-temp oops-temp please-delete; do git branch -D "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; then git push origin --delete "$b"; fi; done; git fetch --prune origin; if ! git rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/v4.9.6 >/dev/null; then git tag -a v4.9.6 -m 'local-agent 4.9.6 stable'; git push origin v4.9.6; fi; python3 -m py_compile agentd.py agent_core.py agent_runtime.py agent_process.py agent_storage.py agent_repository.py agent_repo_worker.py agent_multirepo.py agent_repo_admin.py agentctl.py agent_version.py; python3 -m unittest -q tests.test_agent_multirepo tests.test_agent_repo_worker tests.test_agent_storage; python3 agentctl.py doctor; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo VERSION=$(python3 -c 'import agent_version; print(agent_version.RELEASE_VERSION)'); echo REMOTE_BRANCHES; git branch -r; echo TAG=$(git tag -l v4.9.6); echo FINALIZE_496_OK
